title: Kim Jun-Ho trims 5kg with Mounjaro during ‘Ni ga naera! Dokbak Tour’ in Vietnam - Chosunbiz
text:
Kim Jun-Ho trims 5kg with Mounjaro during ‘Ni ga naera! Dokbak Tour’ in Vietnam - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 11월 1일(일) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Entertainment Kim Jun-Ho trims 5kg with Mounjaro during 'Ni ga naera! Dokbak Tour' in Vietnam 
 입력 2026.11.01. 10:40 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 'Ni ga naera! Dokbak Tour' Kim Jun-Ho succeeded in losing 5kg with Mounjaro.
 On the 31st, the first episode of Channel S's 'Ni ga naera! Dokbak Tour' aired, showing Kim Dae-hee, Kim Jun-Ho, Jang Dong-min, You Se Yoon and Hong In-gyu leaving for Da Nang, Vietnam for the season 6 first trip. In particular, before the trip they tallied the cumulative number of "dokbak" from last season, bringing mixed emotions among the members. Jang Dong-min had a total of 15 dokbaks, spending about 1.73 million won and thus earned the honor of being the one with the fewest dokbaks, but You Se Yoon, with 28 dokbaks and spending about 3.34 million won, bore the dishonor of being the most frequent dokbak. You Se Yoon appealed to the public, saying, "Do not be fooled by Hong In-gyu's 'jingjing' (saying it's hard because he gets dokbak often)," drawing laughter from the start.
 Arriving at Da Nang International Airport, the members expressed satisfaction as the weather was rather cool during the off season rainy period. Kim Jun-Ho raised expectations for the trip, saying the round-trip airfare was cheap and that this time he had booked a luxury accommodation for consecutive nights. The taxi took them to a three-story standalone accommodation prepared by Kim Jun-Ho. The members marveled at the luxurious space, which even had a karaoke room and a swimming pool.
 They immediately changed into swimsuits and started a dokbak game wagering the first night's lodging fee. The result was Hong In-gyu's loss. The members who plunged into the pool enjoyed the trip, saying, "Who says it's the off season?" You Se Yoon suggested betting on the second night's lodging fee by predicting the time it would rain the next day since it was the rainy season and it might rain for a day. As they each chose the time slots they wanted and entered a long game, they headed to My Khe Beach, Da Nang's representative attraction, for a meal.
 In the taxi on the way, time was set aside to reconfirm the cumulative number of dokbaks from last season. When the punishment given to the person with the most dokbaks came up, Kim Jun-Ho brought up his experience of serving as a nude croquis model during the trip to Jeonju. He said he was shocked when he saw his image broadcast and started dieting again, admitting, "I lost about 5kg." Hong In-gyu revealed that even his mother-in-law, an avid viewer of 'Dokbak Tour,' did not watch that particular scene, filling the set with laughter.
 The final tally showed, as expected, that the person with the fewest dokbaks was 'Genius Jang' Jang Dong-min. On the other hand, the person with the most dokbaks was not Hong In-gyu but You Se Yoon. Kim Dae-hee and Jang Dong-min warned Hong In-gyu, who had complained that dokbak was hard every time he was selected, saying, "Don't whine from now on," adding to the laughter.
 At My Khe Beach, the members visited a seafood restaurant made famous by a BTS visit. Without hesitation they ordered the 'BTS set,' and Hong In-gyu expressed a desire even to eat crawfish sashimi. But when Kim Jun-Ho checked the price and reacted that it was burdensome, Hong In-gyu voiced his disappointment, saying, "Jun-ho hyung, because you 'are dieting with Mounjaro' you won't let me order what I want to eat." Caught off guard, Kim Jun-Ho backed down and defused the situation by saying, "Do you want to eat it? Then let's order it."
 Shortly after, various seafood dishes such as raw shrimp sashimi and stir-fried squid filled the table, and the members could not hide their satisfaction at the excellent value. With a meal costing about 270,000 won, another dokbak game took place. Coincidentally, the restaurant was holding a 7.77-second guessing event, and the members used it to compete. Hong In-gyu, who came closest to exactly 7.77 seconds, took first place, while You Se Yoon finished last and had to open his wallet again.
 In the evening they headed to the Son Tra night market, where they could truly feel the local atmosphere of Da Nang. While browsing various shops, the members found a store that prints selected photos on T-shirts and secretly chose each other's photos to make special group T-shirts. While waiting for the clothes to be completed, a balloon-popping game to determine the night market dokbak loser was held. Once again You Se Yoon finished last, reaching a cumulative 30 dokbaks, and he could not hide his devastated expression.
 After enjoying fruit juice and teppan ice cream, the members returned to the shop to check the completed T-shirts. When the so-called 'mocking T-shirts,' which unflinchingly captured each other's dark pasts, were revealed, laughter erupted. Hong In-gyu gifted Kim Jun-Ho a photo from the past nude croquis punishment, and seeing it Kim Jun-Ho tightly shut his eyes, saying, "It's an image I never want to see again..."
 Kim Jun-Ho chose a photo of You Se Yoon from his 'Gaeko monkey' days, and You Se Yoon prepared an image exposing Kim Dae-hee as 'Kkondaehui,' shattering Kim Dae-hee's worldview. Kim Dae-hee put a photo of Jang Dong-min resembling 'Yonsama' from an awards ceremony on a T-shirt as a gift, and Jang Dong-min reciprocated with a photo of Hong In-gyu, who had recently shaved his head during the 'Baekdu Mountain crater' tour. The members' mischievous pranks, summoning each other's dark pasts without reserve, added to the fun of the trip.
 Wearing the 'mocking T-shirts,' the members moved to Da Nang's landmark, the Dragon Bridge. Thousands flocked to the Dragon Bridge crossing the Han River to see the fire show, and the members watched the fire show amid the heated crowd and took various commemorative photos. After sightseeing, they returned to the accommodation and wrapped up the first day in Da Nang by having a lively time in the in-house karaoke room.
